message.content: No, Wolfgang did not inquire about having pizza for dinner after work today prior to suggesting Sichuan hot pot for dinner tonight. According to the records, Wolfgang initially asked Li Hua about having hot pot for dinner tonight at 6 PM at Venedia Grancaffe after his promotion, mentioning that Sichuan is his favorite cuisine. Later, on a different occasion, Wolfgang suggested having pizza for dinner after work, asking Li Hua what her favorite place for pizza is and aiming for a time around 7 PM. These two instances clearly indicate that Wolfgang made these suggestions on separate occasions, not back-to-back.
